title: North Korea linked to another crypto theft over $400 million using compromised accounts, fake video calls and deepfakes
content_md:
Another large-scale cryptocurrency theft worth more than 400 million dollars has been carried out by North Korea. This time the operation used compromised accounts, fake video conferences, recordings of real people and deepfakes...

via Mastodon https://sekurak.pl/kolejne-masowe-kradzieze-kryptowalut-o-wartosci-ponad-400-milionow-dolarow-przez-koree-polnocna-tym-razem-wykorzystujaca-przejete-konta-falszywe-wideokonferencje-nagrania-prawdziwych-osob-i-deepfak/
